rows.label: DEMAND DEPOSIT
rows.clue: A bank deposit from which withdrawals can be made without notice

rows.label: BASE RATE
rows.clue: The interest rate set by the Bank of England for lending to other banks

rows.label: REMITTANCE
rows.clue: A payment of money sent to a person in another place

rows.label: FRINGE BENEFIT
rows.clue: An incidental benefit awarded for certain types of employment (especially if it is regarded as a right)

rows.label: LIST PRICE
rows.clue: The selling price of something as stated in a catalogue or price list

rows.label: VOTING TRUST
rows.clue: An agreement whereby persons owning stock with voting powers retain ownership while transferring the voting rights to the trustees

rows.label: INDIRECT TAX
rows.clue: A tax levied on goods or services rather than on persons or organizations

rows.label: GIFT TAX
rows.clue: A tax imposed on transfers of property by gift during the lifetime of the giver

rows.label: PURCHASE PRICE
rows.clue: The price at which something is actually purchased

rows.label: PAPER GOLD
rows.clue: Reserve assets in the International Monetary Fund

rows.label: HARD CURRENCY
rows.clue: A currency that is not likely to depreciate suddenly in value

rows.label: SEED STOCK
rows.clue: A supply of seeds (or tubers) reserved for planting

rows.label: FREEHOLD
rows.clue: An estate held in fee simple or for life

rows.label: BLUE CHIP
rows.clue: A common stock of a nationally known company whose value and dividends are reliable

rows.label: BUDGET DEFICIT
rows.clue: An excess of expenditures over revenues

rows.label: ENDOWMENT FUND
rows.clue: The capital that provides income for an institution

rows.label: WHITE ELEPHANT
rows.clue: A valuable possession whose upkeep is excessively expensive

rows.label: BRIBE
rows.clue: Payment made to a person in a position of trust to corrupt his judgment

rows.label: PALIMONY
rows.clue: Support paid by one half of an unmarried partnership after the relationship ends

rows.label: VOTING STOCK
rows.clue: Shares in a corporation that entitle the shareholder to voting and proxy rights

rows.label: TAX ADVANTAGE
rows.clue: An advantage bestowed by legislation that reduces a tax on some preferred activity

rows.label: BANK DISCOUNT
rows.clue: Interest on an annual basis deducted in advance on a loan

rows.label: FEE TAIL
rows.clue: A fee limited to a particular line of heirs

rows.label: TAX BREAK
rows.clue: A tax deduction that is granted in order to encourage a particular type of commercial activity

rows.label: REFUND
rows.clue: Money returned to a payer

rows.label: TIME DEPOSIT
rows.clue: A certificate of deposit from which withdrawals can be made only after advance notice or at a specified future date

rows.label: SCRIP
rows.clue: A certificate whose value is recognized by the payer and payee

rows.label: DOLLAR BILL
rows.clue: A piece of paper money worth one dollar

rows.label: GRUBSTAKE
rows.clue: Funds advanced to a prospector or to someone starting a business in return for a share of the profits

rows.label: INTEREST RATE
rows.clue: The percentage of a sum of money charged for its use

rows.label: QUICK ASSETS
rows.clue: Assets in the form of cash (or easily convertible into cash)

rows.label: POOR RATES
rows.clue: A local tax for the relief of the poor

rows.label: TONNAGE
rows.clue: A tax imposed on ships that enter the US

rows.label: SHAREHOLDING
rows.clue: A holding in the form of shares of corporations

rows.label: BOX OFFICE
rows.clue: Total admission receipts for an entertainment

rows.label: SCHOLARSHIP
rows.clue: Financial aid provided to a student on the basis of academic merit

rows.label: PUBLIC DEBT
rows.clue: The total of the nation's debts: debts of local and state and national governments

rows.label: BANK CARD
rows.clue: A credit card issued by a bank

rows.label: FACE VALUE
rows.clue: The value of a security that is set by the company issuing it

rows.label: BORROWING COST
rows.clue: The cost of borrowing something

rows.label: RACK RENT
rows.clue: An extortionate rent

rows.label: DEBIT CARD
rows.clue: A card (usually plastic) that enables the holder to withdraw money or to have the cost of purchases charged directly to the holder's bank account

rows.label: WORLDLY GOODS
rows.clue: All the property that someone possess

rows.label: WEDDING GIFT
rows.clue: A present given to someone getting married

rows.label: GROSS PROFIT
rows.clue: (finance) the net sales minus the cost of goods and services sold

rows.label: SICK BENEFIT
rows.clue: Money paid (by the government) to someone who is too ill to work

rows.label: COMFORTS
rows.clue: Things that make you comfortable and at ease

rows.label: LICENSE FEE
rows.clue: A fee paid to the government for the privilege of being licensed to do something (as selling liquor or practicing medicine)

rows.label: CONTROL STOCK
rows.clue: Shares owned by shareholders who have a controlling interest

rows.label: TITHE
rows.clue: A levy of one tenth of something

rows.label: PAYOFF
rows.clue: The final payment of a debt

rows.label: DOWRY
rows.clue: Money or property brought by a woman to her husband at marriage

rows.label: GRADUATED TAX
rows.clue: Any tax in which the rate increases as the amount subject to taxation increases

rows.label: DIRTY MONEY
rows.clue: Goods or money obtained illegally

rows.label: HIDDEN RESERVE
rows.clue: Reserves that do not show up on the balance sheet (as by understating values)

rows.label: SUBSISTENCE
rows.clue: Minimal (or marginal) resources for subsisting

rows.label: LAND GRANT
rows.clue: A grant of public land (as to a railway or college)

rows.label: HUSH MONEY
rows.clue: A bribe paid to someone to insure that something is kept secret

rows.label: PAY RATE
rows.clue: Amount of money received per unit time

rows.label: TAX INCOME
rows.clue: Government income due to taxation

rows.label: GRATUITY
rows.clue: A relatively small amount of money given for services rendered (as by a waiter)

rows.label: KICKBACK
rows.clue: A commercial bribe paid by a seller to a purchasing agent in order to induce the agent to enter into the transaction

rows.label: CLOBBER
rows.clue: Informal terms for personal possessions

rows.label: MARKUP
rows.clue: The amount added to the cost to determine the asking price

rows.label: LIABILITIES
rows.clue: Anything that is owed to someone else

rows.label: SUBSIDY
rows.clue: A grant paid by a government to an enterprise that benefits the public

rows.label: REVENUE TARIFF
rows.clue: A tariff imposed to raise revenue

rows.label: FIXED COST
rows.clue: A periodic charge that does not vary with business volume (as insurance or rent or mortgage payments etc.)

rows.label: FUNDS
rows.clue: Assets in the form of money

rows.label: STOWAGE
rows.clue: The charge for stowing goods

rows.label: REVENUE
rows.clue: The entire amount of income before any deductions are made

rows.label: REAL PROPERTY
rows.clue: Property consisting of houses and land

rows.label: MARKETING COST
rows.clue: The cost of marketing (e.g., the cost of transferring title and moving goods to the customer)

rows.label: POLL TAX
rows.clue: A tax of a fixed amount per person and payable as a requirement for the right to vote

rows.label: MONEY ORDER
rows.clue: A written order for the payment of a sum to a named individual

rows.label: EXPORT CREDIT
rows.clue: A credit opened by an importer with a bank in an exporter's country to finance an export operation

rows.label: POCKET MONEY
rows.clue: Cash for day-to-day spending on incidental expenses

rows.label: ASKING PRICE
rows.clue: The price at which something is offered for sale

rows.label: STOCK
rows.clue: The capital raised by a corporation through the issue of shares entitling holders to an ownership interest (equity)

rows.label: DEFALCATION
rows.clue: The sum of money that is misappropriated

rows.label: COUNCIL TAX
rows.clue: A tax levied on households by local authorities

rows.label: WHEREWITHAL
rows.clue: The necessary means (especially financial means)

rows.label: HOME LOAN
rows.clue: A loan secured by equity value in the borrower's home

rows.label: EXPENSE
rows.clue: Amounts paid for goods and services that may be currently tax deductible (as opposed to capital expenditures)

rows.label: BANK LOAN
rows.clue: A loan made by a bank

rows.label: PORK BARREL
rows.clue: A legislative appropriation designed to ingratiate legislators with their constituents

rows.label: PROPERTY RIGHT
rows.clue: The legal right of ownership

rows.label: INDEX FUND
rows.clue: A mutual fund whose assets are stocks on a given list

rows.label: NOTE PAYABLE
rows.clue: A note promising to pay a certain amount of money at a certain time

rows.label: MARKET PRICE
rows.clue: The price at which buyers and sellers trade the item in an open marketplace

rows.label: TRADE EXPENSE
rows.clue: Ordinary and necessary expenses incurred in a taxpayer's business or trade

rows.label: TUITION
rows.clue: A fee paid for instruction (especially for higher education)

rows.label: STIPEND
rows.clue: A sum of money allotted on a regular basis

rows.label: NET ESTATE
rows.clue: The estate remaining after debts and funeral expenses and administrative expenses have been deducted from the gross estate

rows.label: LIMITED AUDIT
rows.clue: An audit of limited scope (limited in time span or confined to particular accounts etc.)

rows.label: PAYOLA
rows.clue: A bribe given to a disc jockey to induce him to promote a particular record
